basis: Dermatan sulfate biosynthesis/glycosylation disorder defined by congenital contractures, joint abnormalities and skin fragility; isolated cardiac findings do not establish common damage.
Severe ichthyosis vulgaris affects epidermal keratinization and the skin barrier.
Malignancy of T lymphocytes in blood, marrow or thymus; leukemia alone does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated mechanism.
Retinal malignancy with extraocular spread; the definition does not establish any particular distant organ as affected in at least 30%.
Complete LCAT deficiency defines abnormal lipid metabolism, corneal opacities and progressive nephropathy; hemolytic anemia is characteristic and common (>30%).
Motor neuron disease with denervation amyotrophy and weakness; scoliosis in 2/3 supports common musculoskeletal damage. Respiratory weakness does not establish lung disease.
Angiokeratoma is a superficial dermal vascular lesion with epidermal hyperkeratosis, here located on vulvar skin.
Thymic epithelial malignancy; thymic epithelium has no listed axis. Local invasion lacks a specified common target; associated autoimmune diseases are separate diagnoses.
Congenital persistence of primary vitreous vasculature causes structural vitreoretinal disease.
Inherited LDL cholesterol metabolism disorder; coronary atherosclerosis is a separately diagnosed consequence, and corneal arcus does not impair ocular function.
Neoplasm arising in the breast, which has no axis; pericytic histology does not establish systemic vascular disease.
Squamous carcinoma arising in scrotal skin; nodal spread does not establish common involvement of another listed organ.
Defining recurrent edema affects subcutis, bowel and upper airway. C1-inhibitor dysfunction causes bradykinin-mediated edema rather than autoimmune inflammation.
Defective growth and osteonecrosis at skeletal growth centers define the umbrella condition.
Carcinoma of mammary epithelium; breast has no listed axis.
Congenital structural malformations of kidneys and urinary tract, including vesicoureteral reflux.
Inherited susceptibility form of bipolar affective disorder; psychiatric disease without established damage to a listed organ.
Growth hormone-secreting pituitary adenoma; acromegaly or gigantism and their organ complications are separately diagnosed conditions.
Acute myeloid malignancy of marrow and blood defined by the FUS-ERG-associated translocation.
Disease of blood vessels supplying male genital organs; the vascular process falls within the cardiovascular axis.
HNRNPU-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy causes seizures, intellectual disability and impaired brain development.
Stromal neoplasms arising in the vagina; reproductive organs have no listed axis.
Primary torsion dystonia is a neurologic movement disorder; blepharospasm and torticollis do not establish separate ocular or skeletal tissue damage.
Adenocarcinoma arising from mammary glandular epithelium; breast has no listed axis despite its integumentary ancestry.
Thoracic myelomeningocele involves spinal cord and vertebral closure defects; neurogenic bladder with urinary dysfunction occurs in most patients (>80%).
